DecisionAlternative.description: A candidate implementation considered for a planning decision.

id.description: Stable alternative identifier within the decision.

OutcomeSummary.description: A predicted or observed outcome summary, kept distinct by its enclosing event.

metrics.description: Metric values, keyed by metric name.

description: A planning decision and its prediction, recorded independently of outcomes.

baseline_alternative.description: Alternative used as the comparison baseline, if applicable.

compiler_recommendation.description: Compiler recommendation, if one was made.

compiler_runs.description: IDs of compiler runs (`metrics.jsonl` event IDs) that informed this decision. Explicit attribution only: `pc evaluate` costs exactly these runs and never guesses by timestamp. Empty when no run was recorded as informing the decision.

constraints.description: Constraints applied while making the decision.

decision_provenance.description: Explanation of who or what made the final decision.

id.description: Stable event identifier supplied by the recorder.

initial_decision.description: Alternative the planner intended before seeing the compiler recommendation, when it was recorded.

plan_revision.description: Revision of the plan used for the event.

predicted_outcome.description: Predicted result; this is not observed evidence.

project_revision.description: Revision of the project being planned.

schema_version.description: Event schema version. PC-02 defines version 1.

source.description: Event producer, such as `pc-cli` or an agent identifier.

title: DecisionEvent
